name: S&P Global (S&P Dow Jones Indices)
description: S&P Dow Jones Indices, the S&P Global division that owns the S&P 500 and the S&P CoreLogic Case-Shiller home price indices (branded S&P Cotality Case-Shiller on FRED as of 2026, reflecting CoreLogic's rename to Cotality). Three things reach this site from it: the quarterly S&P 500 earnings workbook, downloaded by hand until its publisher discontinued the public file; the S&P 500 index level, which FRED carries under S&P DJI's copyright; and the Case-Shiller home price indices, also carried by FRED under S&P DJI's copyright.

notes: The index page and S&P DJI's pages return HTTP 403 to automated fetches (WebFetch, and curl with a browser user-agent, on 2026-09-14 and 2026-09-15); read them in a browser. Read in Claude in Chrome on 2026-09-15: the terms URL catalogued in S8 (https://www.spglobal.com/spdji/en/terms-of-use/) is a 404 page, so the 403 was hiding a dead link. S&P DJI's footer links to its Legal Disclaimer page (https://www.spglobal.com/spdji/en/disclaimers/, which carries the reproduction terms for index data) and to S&P Global's corporate Terms of Use (https://www.spglobal.com/en/terms-of-use, whose copying restriction is about credit ratings).
The workbook is committed as reference_resources/sp-500-eps-est.xlsx and turned into data/earnings_overrides.json by scripts/build_earnings_overrides.py (see CLAUDE.md, quarterly update).

The index page's Additional Info section, expanded in a browser on 2026-09-15, lists four documents: At a Glance: SPIVA After-Tax Scorecard; S&P 500® The Gauge of the U.S. Large-Cap Market; S&P 500 GICS Scorecard; S&P 500 Stock Buybacks. No earnings workbook is listed. A search index still shows https://www.spglobal.com/spdji/en/documents/additional-material/sp-500-eps-est.xlsx, which returns 403 to curl; it was not downloaded, so whether that URL serves anything after the 31 Jan 2026 discontinuation is unconfirmed.

terms.summary: S&P Dow Jones Indices prohibits redistributing or reproducing its content, including index data, in whole or in part without its written permission
terms.quote: Redistribution or reproduction in whole or in part are prohibited without written permission of S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC.

datasets.name: S&P 500 quarterly earnings per share (as-reported and operating)
datasets.gives: Quarterly as-reported (GAAP) and operating earnings per share for the S&P 500, with the sheet's own data-as-of and actuals-through dates, plus bottom-up estimates for coming quarters
notes: The workbook's own notice says S&P's public EPS files ended 31 January 2026 (read from reference_resources/sp-500-eps-est.xlsx, not from a web page). The site's P/E has run on forward-filled earnings since; finding a replacement source is the first open item in catalog/research-log.md.
Coverage start is the earliest quarter in data/earnings_overrides.json (quarter ending 1988-12-31, 148 quarters through 2025-09-30).
Lag of 60 business days is the descriptor's working figure (scorecards appeared roughly two months after quarter end), not a published schedule.

datasets.name: S&P 500 index level, daily
datasets.gives: The S&P 500 price index at the market close, from S&P Dow Jones Indices, carried by FRED as series SP500 under a rolling ten-year window

terms.summary: S&P Dow Jones Indices copyright, via FRED: reproduction of the S&P 500 in any form is prohibited without S&P's prior written permission
terms.quote: Copyright © 2016, S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC. All rights reserved. Reproduction of S&P 500 in any form is prohibited except with the prior written permission of S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC ("S&P").

notes: FRED's notes: 'The Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis and S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC have reached a new agreement … FRED and its associated services will include 10 years of daily history for Standard & Poors and Dow Jones Averages series.' The coverage start therefore moves forward one day at a time (2016-09-15 on 2026-09-14).
Price index, not total return: no dividends.
Lag observed: the 2026-09-14 close was on FRED at 7:01 PM CDT the same day.

series/sp500_pe.json takes FRED's monthly average of this series (frequency=m, aggregation_method=avg) as its price input; the P/E chart's table and CSV export include that monthly average price. Whether that is within S&P's terms is an open item in catalog/research-log.md.

datasets.name: S&P CoreLogic Case-Shiller home price indices, monthly
datasets.gives: S&P DJI's repeat-sales home price indices, carried by FRED: the U.S. National index (not seasonally adjusted and seasonally adjusted variants) and the 20-City and 10-City Composite indices (seasonally adjusted)

terms.summary: S&P Dow Jones Indices copyright, via FRED: reproduction of the S&P Case-Shiller indices in any form is prohibited without S&P's prior written permission; FRED labels every Case-Shiller series "Copyrighted: Pre-Approval Required". The 20-City and 10-City Composite series (SPCS20RSA, SPCS10RSA) carry this explicit prohibition sentence; the National index (CSUSHPINSA, CSUSHPISA) instead carries the shorter "Copyright, 2016, Standard & Poor's Financial Services LLC. Reprinted with permission." — see notes.
terms.quote: Copyright © 2016, S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC. All rights reserved. Reproduction of S&P Case-Shiller 20-City Home Price Index in any form is prohibited except with the prior written permission of S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC "S&P".

notes: FRED API (2026-09-15): CSUSHPINSA and CSUSHPISA (both titled "S&P Cotality Case-Shiller U.S. National Home Price Index", not-seasonally-adjusted and seasonally-adjusted) and SPCS10RSA cover 1987-01 onward; SPCS20RSA (20-City Composite) covers 2000-01 onward — later than the other three. `coverage.start` above is the earliest of the four; the 20-city series starts 13 years later.

FRED's own series titles now read "S&P Cotality Case-Shiller ..." rather than "S&P CoreLogic Case-Shiller ..." — CoreLogic rebranded to Cotality; the index methodology and rights holder (S&P Dow Jones Indices) are unchanged.
All four series are seasonally adjusted except CSUSHPINSA (NSA) and CSUSHPISA (SA) are the same National index in each variant; SPCS20RSA and SPCS10RSA are SA-only on FRED.

publication_lag_business_days (42) is the observed gap between the FRED API's last_updated (2026-08-27) and the period the newest observation covers (month ending 2026-06-30), not a published release schedule from S&P DJI (their site is 403 to automated fetches — see access.notes).

Each FRED series page's own copyright label reads "Copyrighted: Pre-Approval Required" (checked via WebFetch for CSUSHPINSA, CSUSHPISA, SPCS20RSA, SPCS10RSA on 2026-09-15) — the same label FRED uses for the S&P 500 (SP500) dataset above.

Re-checked 2026-09-15 (S9 fix): the four series' copyright notices are not identical. CSUSHPINSA and CSUSHPISA (the National index) carry only "Copyright, 2016, Standard & Poor's Financial Services LLC. Reprinted with permission." — no explicit reproduction-prohibition sentence. SPCS20RSA and SPCS10RSA each carry the longer "Reproduction of S&P Case-Shiller <20-City|10-City> Home Price Index in any form is prohibited except with the prior written permission..." sentence, naming their own index. `terms.quote` above is SPCS20RSA's wording (verbatim there); `terms.url` points to SPCS20RSA rather than CSUSHPINSA for that reason. `status: restricted` is kept for all four series under one entry since none of the four is unrestricted, but no single quote is verbatim across all four series' pages.
Not yet used by any series/*.json descriptor as of 2026-09-15 (roadmap item, not built).
